# Evidence digest — Hiero 2027 annual review

Everything below is quoted from the published analytics data API so the report can be
written from facts, not memory. Tiles are headline numbers; tables and charts carry a
dashboard deep link and a JSON path. Re-generate with the weekly workflow.

## Provenance

- Data as of: **2026-10-06**
- Source commit: 62a5652
- API root: https://analytics.hiero.org/data/api/v1/
- Dashboard: https://analytics.hiero.org/ (org `hiero-ledger`)

## Headline tiles

### Contributors

- **contributors: 1481** — Distinct people with any tracked activity in the organisation, all-time. The denominator for every percentage tile on this tab.
- **active last month %: 10%** — The share of all-time contributors who did something in the last 30 days — a staleness check on the contributor base, not a measure of output.
- **multi-repo %: 32%** — The share of contributors active in two or more repositories — how much the contributor base spans the organisation rather than sitting in one project.
- **file issues %: 52%** — The share of contributors who have opened at least one issue.
- **open PRs %: 72%** — The share of contributors who have authored at least one pull request. Used as the proxy for “writes code”: commits themselves are not ingested, only PRs.
- **give reviews %: 36%** — The share of contributors who have reviewed at least one pull request — the review load's breadth, not its volume.
- **completed a GFI %: 22%** — The share of contributors who have merged a PR closing an onboarding (good-first-issue) ticket — the clearest signal that onboarding paths actually convert.

### Governance

- **maintainers: 104** — People whose *highest* role anywhere in the organisation is maintainer. Counted at the highest role so the role tiles partition the permission-holders without double-counting.
- **committers: 130** — People whose highest role anywhere is committer (write access, but not maintainer).
- **triage: 7** — People whose highest role anywhere is triage (label and issue management, no merge rights).
- **maintainer affiliations known: 99%** — The share of maintainers whose affiliation is resolved to a named employer or Independent. The organisation-diversity pie uses this resolved population as its denominator.
- **committer affiliations known: 77%** — The share of highest-role committers whose affiliation is resolved to a named employer or Independent. Read the committer organisation-diversity pie against this coverage.
- **quiet permission-holders (180d+): 98** — People holding a granted role who have had no tracked activity for 180 days or more — an access-hygiene list, not a judgement about the people on it.
- **quiet teams: 3** — Governance teams where no member has had tracked activity for 180 days or more — a team that exists on paper but is not currently doing the work its grants imply. The threshold is fixed, not the tab's selected period.

### Releases

- **repos with releases: 26 of 44** — How many repos have ever published a GitHub Release, out of the org's full repo count. Most zero-release repos are docs/governance/meta repos, not neglected code — this tile is the denominator the other release tiles are scoped to, so that scoping is visible.
- **released last 90d %: 77%** — Of repos that have ever released (not the full repo universe), the share that shipped a release in the last 90 days.
- **>3x their own typical gap: 7** — Repos currently more than 3x past their own typical release gap — furthest behind *relative to their own pace*, not by raw days. A repo with a naturally long cadence isn't counted just for having one; only repos with an established cadence (2+ releases) are eligible.
